hero.subtitle: Four apartments for 2 to 5 guests, 800 m from downtown. Equipped kitchen, split heat-and-cool AC, WiFi and a garden with grills.

sections.unitsIntro: Four apartments for 2 to 5 guests, 800 meters from downtown Capilla del Monte. Each has an equipped kitchen, electric water heater, split heat-and-cool air conditioning and fiber-optic WiFi. Free access to the garden, with loungers, grills and tables.

spaces.blurb: All four apartments have free access to the garden: lawn, loungers, tables and two grills, among lavender and rose beds, with the hills behind.
